title: Create the Pioneer financing and downside IC memo
prompt:
Create this file:
`Deliverables/Pioneer acquisition financing IC memorandum - 7.6.docx`

Begin with the July corporate-development investment-committee thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's banker-case warning. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Create a concise investment-committee memorandum with `Executive Recommendation`, `Sources and Uses`, `Financing Economics`, `Base Case`, `Downside Case`, `Covenants and Liquidity`, `Decision Conditions`, and `Appendix: Source Reconciliation`. Add actual-funded financing fees to closing uses and fund them in approved source priority without exceeding commitments; do not deduct funded fees from ending cash twice. Include MCP-posted existing funded debt in gross leverage. Apply fees, interest, and amortization to actual funded amounts; debt-service coverage uses documented acquisition debt service because no existing-note service schedule is supplied. Test leverage, debt-service coverage, and minimum cash independently. Use a real Word table for Base/Downside metrics and clearly reject or condition any structure with a funding or guardrail failure.

Also include interest-rate stress, Year-2 amortization and working-capital burn, revolver backstop, and stressed approval conditions. Show the original-rate Downside case separately from the rate-stressed Downside case, including original-rate Downside cash headroom. Report original-rate Downside closing gross leverage before Year-1 amortization separately from any post-Year-1-amortization leverage view. Apply each annual amortization percent to the facility's original actual-funded closing principal in both years, capped at remaining principal; it is not a declining-balance percentage. Roll stressed Downside Year-1 ending cash into Year 2 and calculate Year-2 stressed interest on opening Year-2 principal after Year-1 amortization. Explicitly report Year-2 ending acquisition debt after scheduled amortization, excluding existing Alder Ridge debt and the revolver backstop, separately from Year-2 ending gross funded debt. Also report Year-2 stressed gross leverage, debt-service coverage, and cash headroom to the minimum, and include all three in the stressed compliance conclusion.

Document the controlling sources in the deliverable, recalculate or render the finished file as appropriate, and save it to the exact target path.

Keep the shared company workspace clean: change only the requested target file and do not leave behind draft scripts or temporary exports.
